ownerWords: make sure that the food deficit math and the band visual are correct
cause: THE VIEW RE-DERIVED THREE NUMBERS ITS WRITER ALREADY HELD, AND GOT TWO OF THEM WRONG. generateFoodSecurity (economicState.foodSecurity) is the single writer of the food economics; deriveFoodBalanceAnalysis (economicViability.metrics.foodBalance) is a VIEW of it, and generators-domain-4 had already made its production, need and deficit follow the writer. What the view still computed for itself was WHO CARRIES THE GAP and WHAT MULTIPLIER GREW THE FOOD, and both re-derivations had drifted off the model they describe. (1) THE IMPORT GATE ASKED THE WRONG MODEL. `canImportFood` tested the view's own LOCAL rawDeficit — the figure the canonical block three lines below has just superseded — so any settlement whose local model read a surplus while the writer read a real gap was credited with ZERO imports and a magical offset covering the whole thing. That is not a corner: the local model reads geographyData's agricultureCapacity and the writer produces at foodGenerator's TERRAIN_AGRI, and the two tables disagree on five of seven terrains (plains 1.5 vs 1.0, riverside 1.3 vs 0.9, hills 0.9 vs 0.6, forest 0.6 vs 0.5, coastal 0.8 vs 0.7), so the local model reads high almost everywhere. MEASURED: 52 of the golden master's 525 configurations, each one dropping its '+ N imported' chip, its blue import run on the balance bar, its 'Trade covers X% of gap' caption and its importChannel from the Economics tab, and its 'imports cover X% of gap' line from the PDF chapter and the PDF overview — a town importing 35% of its food told the reader magic fed it. The writer's own split is published and read instead; the rate ladder the view re-derived had also never taken the writer's low-agri terrain boost, and that second drift dies with it. (2) THE AGRICULTURE MODIFIER NAMED A TABLE NO LONGER IN PLAY. foodBalance.agricultureModifier carried geographyData's terrain agricultureCapacity while the production figure printed beside it — 'Agriculture modifier: 150%' over 'Production: N lbs/day' on the Economics tab, 'Ag mod 1.5' in the PDF — had been computed by the writer at TERRAIN_AGRI. MEASURED: 376 of 525 printed a modifier their own production contradicts. It now carries the writer's effectiveAgriculture (terrain capacity + the resource/institution bonus + registered custom producers, capped at 2.0), which is the only reading under which the printed pair reconstructs the printed production — pinned by reconstructing it inside the writer's seeded ±8% crop-fortune band. ⛔ NO TUNING CONSTANT MOVED: TERRAIN_AGRI, TERRAIN_DATA and FOOD_IMPORT_RATES are untouched, and the tuning signature stays the owner's. (3) ONE RESIDUAL PERCENTAGE, NOT TWO. deriveFoodBalance re-derived its 'X% of need' from the published INTEGER pounds while the Daily Life tab, foodNarrative and the AI brief printed the record's own deficitPercent; the two agreed on 513 of 525 and split by a point on the twelve smallest, where a thorp's 2.4 lb residual against a 60 lb need is 4% on the record and 3% off the rounded pounds. The display model now states the record's figure and keeps the derivation as the arm for a record carrying none. ── THE MOVEMENT, MEASURED SINGLE-VARIABLE against base 262ff919c by generating the whole corpus at base and at tip and structurally diffing every settlement: EXACTLY NINE PATHS CHANGE ACROSS ALL 525 SETTLEMENTS, and nothing else in the object moves. FIVE are the writer's new additive fields, 525 of 525 each — economicState.foodSecurity.{rawDeficit, importCoverage, magicOffset, deficit, effectiveAgriculture}. FOUR are the cure — economicViability.metrics.foodBalance.agricultureModifier 376 of 525, .importCoverage 199, .magicFoodOffset 199, .importChannel 55 (null → a named channel). Strip the five additive fields and 437 of 525 rows move with 88 unchanged, the 88 being mostly mountain and desert, where the two agriculture tables already agreed. ⭐ WHAT DID NOT MOVE, MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED, 0 of 525 on every one: the band word, colour and bar — foodSecurity.label, .color, .bg, .resilienceScore — and the numbers it is cut from, .deficitPct and .surplusPct; .prosperityMod and prosperity itself; foodBalance.deficit, .rawDeficit, .deficitPercent, .surplus and .magicFoodNote; economicViability.summary and every viability issue, warning and plot hook; every roster, faction and array length; the 525-key set is identical and no rng draw moved. THE BAND VISUAL IS THEREFORE UNTOUCHED BY THIS CAR — it was audited and found correct, and the audit's two residual findings are display-side and frozen, recorded below. On espionage-dormancy-fence's own 360-settlement corpus 360 OF 360 ROWS MOVE (60 per tier, every settlement carrying the five new writer fields), 360/360 hashes stay distinct, and the constant reads 38a26ac1ca7b7e5bb81d9e7795851b57ca32d50f5a36d78b41e564ccd731f196 -> 6ffc462c6a73f85ca2396053bacadb71d3e1904a265bdc9c90a6e59b5d71d089 AT THE LANE'S TIP. ── TWO CONVICTED DEFECTS ARE NOT CURED HERE, AND THEY ARE DEFERRED DELIBERATELY, NOT DROPPED. Both are single-line edits to EconomicsTab.jsx templates whose EXACT snippets are frozen rows in tests/lint/.prose-numerics-baseline.json, which this lane is instructed to report and never edit; both need one line of that baseline re-addressed in the same act, which is a door. (a) EconomicsTab.jsx:546 prints 'Agricultural surplus of 0% above daily needs.' whenever deficit and surplus are both zero — which includes every settlement whose production gap is FULLY closed by imports or magic, a town that does not feed itself being told it has a surplus. The tile beside it already computes the right word, 'Balanced'; the sentence needs a third branch. (b) EconomicsTab.jsx:544's three-clause deficit sentence states production cover and import cover and then a residual that neither explains, because magic closes the rest silently: 'covers 29%' + 'imports cover 50% of gap' reads out to a 35% residual beside a printed 12%, on 174 of 525 configurations after this car (144 before it, the rise being settlements that correctly regained their import clause). The model already carries magicFoodOffset and magicFoodNote for exactly this and the tab reads neither. ── ALSO AUDITED AND FOUND SOUND, over 525 golden-corpus settlements plus 312 more sweeping the stress types, the magic and religion priorities, mountain_pass, none and every tier-terrain pair: deficit = need − production when positive and 0 otherwise; importCoverage + magicFoodOffset === rawDeficit − deficit EXACTLY, not within a pound; every percentage inside [0,100]; no NaN or Infinity at population 10 or with need at zero; rounding performed once at the edge; 'Production covers X%' never above 100 in a deficit sentence; deficit and surplus never both positive; and the balance bar's filled run is exactly the ratio the sentence beside it states, pinned in the DOM. TWO SUB-POUND ARTEFACTS ARE RECORDED AND NOT CURED, both pre-existing and both arithmetic on the published integers rather than a defect of the model: a ten-soul thorp with a 0.4 lb residual against a 20 lb need publishes deficit 0 and deficitPct 2, and the import/magic proportion can shift by up to 3 points on a hamlet whose whole coverage is under twenty pounds.
